scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by a full analytic proof and separately by bounded exact-rational checks. Finite checks are not a proof of the general statement.
scientific_limitations: Only zero lower bound and strictly positive ceiling increments; no statement for skew shapes, zero increments, or generic flow polytopes. Independent publication-priority checking is outstanding.
title: An additive Minkowski-asymmetry law and center-dimension phases for generalized Pitman–Stanley polytopes
